# AI Disclosure
## Files that were generated by AI
- ./site/html/ - Site was generated via AI
- ./ansible/roles/kubeadm_control/templates/etcd-backup.sj.j2 - etcd backup process changed in latest version, asked AI to generate the backup script and explain sources so I don't leave a cluster in a bad way.
- ./terraform-libvirt - After the third loss of access to my lab I had AI generate a compatible libvirt version maintaining what I had used for the proxmox deployment.
- ./docs/evidence - Given the rquirements for the assignemnt, I asked for a validator script that would validate that the configuration is working as intended and build out a report. It is placed here.

## Usage
I primarily use AI for more efficient document searching. If I have questions about a particular error, config param, or proces I will ask for a link to documentation. These prompts generally lead with a instruction to provide the requested information without modifying the file and I work in manual approval mode.
